article.story: BOCA RATON, Fla. -- — Josh Harris scored 25 points as Florida Atlantic beat William & Mary 95-90 on Wednesday. Harris added eight rebounds for the Owls (2-1). Kanaan Carlyle and Jelani Hamilton each had 21 points, and Carlyle tacked on seven rebounds. Brian Carter Jr. finished with 21 points, six assists and two steals for the Tribe (2-1). William & Mary also got 15 points and four assists from Josh Baldwin. Gavin Ward had 11 points. Harris scored 12 points in the first half and Florida Atlantic went into halftime trailing 42-39. Carlyle scored 15 points in the second half to help lead Florida Atlantic to a five-point victory. Up next Florida Atlantic plays Saturday against Coastal Georgia at home, and William & Mary visits Michigan on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
